05-31-1508 is May 31, 1508.  
18 weeks + 7 days = 19 weeks total (since 7 days = 1 week).  
19 weeks = 133 days.  
Subtract 133 days from May 31, 1508:  
April has 30 days, so May 31 minus 31 days = May 0 → April 30.  
April 30 minus another 30 days = April 0 → March 31.  
March 31 minus remaining 72 days (133 - 31 - 30 = 72):  
March has 31 days, so March 31 minus 31 = March 0 → February 29 (1508 is a leap year, divisible by 4).  
February 29 minus 29 days = February 0 → January 31.  
January 31 minus remaining 12 days (72 - 31 - 29 - 12) = January 19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1508-01-19
